data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: generative-ai-for-beginners
ui_devex.summary: 《生成式AI入门指南》是一个包含21节课程的完整学习路径，通过Jupyter笔记本实践教学，帮助初学者系统掌握生成式AI的核心技术。课程深入讲解提示工程、模型微调等关键概念，并展示如何集成Azure AI服务和OpenAI API进行实际开发。学习者可以按照结构化课程构建真实应用，体验不同AI模型的效果，掌握在实际项目中部署生成式AI解决方案的方法，为深入探索人工智能领域打下坚实基础。
ui_devex.summary_en: Generative AI for Beginners is a comprehensive 21-lesson curriculum that demystifies generative AI for newcomers by providing hands-on learning through Jupyter notebooks. It teaches core concepts like prompt engineering and model fine-tuning while demonstrating practical integration with Azure AI services and OpenAI APIs. Developers can follow the structured lessons to build real applications, experiment with different AI models, and understand how to deploy generative AI solutions effectively in their projects.

ui_devex.name: kaneo
ui_devex.summary: kaneo 是一款开源、自托管的项目管理工具，定位为 Jira 或 Linear 的轻量级替代品。它提供看板、问题追踪及简洁界面，聚焦核心功能而非复杂性。基于 TypeScript、React 和 Hono 构建，强调简洁、用户可控与易自托管，采用 MIT 许可证。团队可将之部署于自有基础设施以管理工作流，免受供应商锁定与功能臃肿之扰，适合
ui_devex.summary_en: kaneo is an open-source, self-hosted project management tool positioned as a lightweight alternative to Jira or Linear. It provides kanban boards, issue tracking, and a clean interface centered on essential features rather than complexity. Built with TypeScript, React, and Hono, it emphasizes simplicity, user control, and easy self-hosting under the MIT license. Teams can deploy it on their own infrastructure to manage workflows without vendor lock-in or feature bloat. It suits small teams needing a straightforward, customizable issue tracker.

framework_core.summary_es: Generative AI for Beginners is a comprehensive 21-lesson curriculum that demystifies generative AI for newcomers by providing hands-on learning through Jupyter notebooks. It teaches core concepts like prompt engineering and model fine-tuning while demonstrating practical integration with Azure AI services and OpenAI APIs. Developers can follow the structured lessons to build real applications, experiment with different AI models, and understand how to deploy generative AI solutions effectively in their projects.

agents_workflows.summary_en: kaneo is an open-source, self-hosted project management tool positioned as a lightweight alternative to Jira or Linear. It provides kanban boards, issue tracking, and a clean interface centered on essential features rather than complexity. Built with TypeScript, React, and Hono, it emphasizes simplicity, user control, and easy self-hosting under the MIT license. Teams can deploy it on their own infrastructure to manage workflows without vendor lock-in or feature bloat. It suits small teams needing a straightforward, customizable issue tracker.
